I teach undergraduate statistics and econometrics at the Department of Economics, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU).

## Department of Economics, NTNU

Current courses:

**[SØK1004 — Statistics for Economists](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/S%C3%98K1004)**  
An introductory course covering probability, statistical inference and the use of statistical methods in economics.

**[SØK1005 — Econometrics](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/S%C3%98K1005)**  
An introduction to regression analysis, econometric inference, model assumptions and the interpretation of empirical economic research.

## NTNU Business School

Previous courses:

**[MET1002 — Statistics for Economists](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/MET1002)**  
An introductory course in descriptive statistics, probability, estimation and statistical hypothesis testing, with applications to economics and business.

**[MET2010 — Applied Statistics](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/MET2010)**  
An intermediate course in applied data analysis covering multiple regression, analysis of variance, statistical testing and the interpretation of empirical results.

Official course information is available through the NTNU course catalogue.

## External examining

I serve as an external examiner across a broad range of economics courses, including microeconomics, macroeconomics and quantitative and applied economics. Institutions I have examined for include the University of Bergen (UiB), the University of Stavanger (UiS), NHH Norwegian School of Economics, BI Norwegian Business School and NTNU.
